name: Matches beside a match (a member's)
description: THE MEMBER'S COPY of soma-pub-matches-related: the same statement with the session's claims, so a private season answers to its participants, its season admins and platform admins (season_visible), and to anyone else exactly as the public route does. Uncached, because the answer depends on the viewer. The watch rail: twelve cards beside one PUBLIC match, from its own season. Six of the latest matches of the models seated in it, taken in turns -- each model's newest, then each one's next -- the winner's model first in every round; three more on the same board; then the season's latest. Deduplicated -- a match keeps the first group it falls in -- and the match itself excluded. Every candidate is match_counted(), the season listing's own rule. A model's latest are read backwards off its versions' rating_events, and the board and season groups off the season's played index, each stopping at its LIMIT, so none sorts the season. 404 for a match that is not public.
